items.headline: Flood Watch issued October 13 at 10:57AM AKDT until October 16 at 1:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
A stronger atmospheric river is expected to move over the panhandle
beginning early Thursday morning and continuing through at least
Friday morning. Multiple waves moving up will bring persistent
moderate to heavy rain for much of the southern half of the
panhandle. Past early Friday morning, additional periods of heavy
rain are possible, but confidence is moderate to low at this time.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 13 at 9:41AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
Thursday into the weekend, a series of low pressure systems will
move toward Southeast Alaska, bringing widespread moderate to heavy
rainfall. Strong winds are also expected for coastal and southern
panhandle communities. While the exact timing and impacts of the
system are still being refined, confidence is continuing to increase
that this will be a more impactful system for Southeast Alaska.
